cards.text: Dusk: give 2 random animals in your hand +1 strength.

cards.name: Silverback
cards.text: Roar: give all animals in your hand +2 strength.
Whenever this gains strength in your hand, it evolves. (Egg, Caterpillar, Chrysalis, Butterfly, Monarch.)
Flight. Apex Predator. When this enters your hand, add [its mate] to your hand.

cards.name: Macaque
cards.text: Roar: if you have 5 or more cards in your hand, remove an adjacent enemy.

cards.name: Orangutan
cards.text: Roar: duplicate a Primate in your hand.

cards.name: Tarsier
cards.text: Roar: Scout a Primate and give it +1 strength.

cards.name: Chimpanzee
cards.text: Roar: remove an adjacent enemy of equal or lower strength.

cards.name: Baboon
cards.text: Roar: give 2 animals in your hand +1 strength.

cards.name: Stork
cards.text: Flight. Roar: add two random younglings to your hand.

cards.name: Grizzly Bear
cards.text: Has +1 strength for each card in your hand.

cards.name: Caterpillar
cards.text: When this gains strength in your hand, draw a card and turn this into a Butterfly.

cards.name: Gorilla
cards.text: Roar: if this has 8 or more strength, draw a card.
